title: The Witness of Ashcombe
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Sable Halloran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
